## Project Goals and Objectives

This project acts as a monitoring tool to track specific, reliable accounts on the social platform X (formerly Twitter) to assess potential investment opportunities for a financial portfolio earlier than users needing to manually assess posted details.

## Process and Approach

- Initial outline consists of accounts database, scripts to run three-phase system described below, configuration.
- Three-phase system:
  - Scraper to capture posts on X from selected accounts.
  - Scoring model to assess which posts have sufficient engagement and engagement velocity; extra priority for more valuable accounts.
  - AI to develop summary based on scraped information and scoring model from prior steps along with [Sentiment_Analysis_Stock_Tweets_FineTuned](https://huggingface.co/vidhivaish03/Sentiment_Analysis_Stock_Tweets_FineTuned) for sentiment analysis and [phrase-ticker](https://huggingface.co/datasets/rohanmahen/phrase-ticker) for ticker extraction; results sent to a Telegram bot created by the user(s).
- Reinforced process to run `X_Stock_Scrape` and ensure Telegram messages are transmitted.
- Updated AI output process to filter down to only messages that can determine tickers, one alert per ticker when post mentions multiple tickers; posts that do not contain extracted tickers will be disregarded.
- Signal quality tests for ticker extraction, sentiment direction, confidence floors, bullish and bearish full-pipeline examples, and the no-ticker case. The module loads the Hugging Face dataset and sentiment model through a module-scoped fixture.

## Evaluation and Future Improvements

- Most signals provided are of neutral sentiment with insufficient price data; considering methods to filter down noise.
- Consider setting multiple price exit targets to avoid suggestions from being too restrictive.
- The suite is not hermetic and its ticker-only tests execute before the model fixture has necessarily populated the ticker dataset.
